run.notes: BEA 2017 summary IO; concordance status COARSE_APPROXIMATION

concordance.aggregation_loss: Each 10-digit commodity line carries exactly one NAICS industry in the official concordance, so no within-line weighting assumption is made. Aggregation loss remains only where Census itself writes an 'X' in a NAICS code to hide undisclosed detail, and where a line's NAICS falls outside the BEA summary manufacturing and primary groups. 172 codes carry a different NAICS in a later vintage; the pre-treatment assignment governs, and that count bounds how much the choice matters.
concordance.warnings: 64 products have no commodity mapping and are excluded

warnings: 154 lines carried a NAICS code retired by the 2012->2017 classification revision; the successor code for the same line in the 2020 vintage was used (335221->335220, 333911->333914, 335228->335220, 335224->335220, 335222->335220, 211112->211130)
172 codes carry a different NAICS in a later vintage than in 2017; the pre-treatment assignment is used, and this count bounds how much that choice matters
450 codes are absent from the 2017 vintage and were taken from a later one; these are commodity lines created after the primary year
official_concordance.method: Official Census import concordances, one file per year, keyed on the 10-digit commodity code. The pre-treatment vintage governs the industry assignment so it is pre-determined like the weights; later vintages only supply codes created after that year.
